_comment: The real cluster topology. Copy to /opt/tinyfaas/nodes.json on the
leader and point NODES_CONFIG at it.
Relay A = 2brr, Relay B = 2bro. These UIDs differ only in the last
character, so check them against Brick Viewer rather than by eye.
channel is the channel ON THAT RELAY (0 or 1), not a cluster-wide index.
The leader is never power-cycled and so has no relay or channel.
